summary: Engine.Run no longer descends into testdata or vendor directories, or into a directory that is the root of its own Go module (a go.mod file present). This replaces reliance on the user-maintained exclude-files regex list for these cases with automatic module and package boundary detection.
trust_boundaries: Engine.Run now calls fs.Stat on the walked fs.FS to detect a nested go.mod before descending into a directory. No package dependency, CLI flag, configuration key, report field, exit code, or network destination changes.
